svg.title: Journey, 2023 to now
svg.desc: 2023: Founded ZudoMart. Started the backend that became a 79-module Go monolith. 2025: Newdich Technology. Backend Engineer on Eko Xpedite Exchange: merchant, agent and end-user flows. Jan 2026: EquityPilot. ZudoMart joined FasterCapital's EquityPilot programme. 2026: Shipped in the open. Zudojs, Kolo, Telente CBT, Telente Store, Utils-tool, PowerWatch, LearnBridge, Zudo POS. Now: Security and data. SentinelX, CommitGuard and Scriptune, alongside a BSc in Computer Science.
